speaker: Nora (US English (native))
text: Hi, Alex. This is Nora from the front office. Welcome to the team! Here is a quick guide, so you know who to ask. If your laptop or the wifi does not work, call Tom. He is the person who handles all computer problems. If you need a day off, talk to Elena. She is the manager who approves every request. For invoices and payments, go to Priya in the Finance department. She is the colleague who signs off on every payment. If a machine stops, tell Marco. He is the technician who repairs the machines on Line Two. And if you are not sure, ask me! I am the person who answers the phone. Please make sure you save these names. I will keep you posted about the phone numbers. See you on Monday!
